definitions.usage: delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.
definitions.full: H2655. chaphets חָפֵץ verbal adjective delighting in, having pleasure in ; — ׳ח Psa 5:5 4 t.; plural חֲפֵצִים Mal 3:1 ; Neh 1:11 ; construct חֲפֵצֵי Psa 35:27 2 t.; suffix חֶפְצֵיהֶם 111:2 ; feminine חֲפֵצָ֑ה 1Chr 28:9 ; — 1 of man , with accusative Psa 34:13 ; 35:27 ; Mal 3:1 ; with infinitive Neh 1:11 ; absolute הֶחָפֵץ whosoever would 1Kin 13:33 ; אתה חפץ אם if thou pleasest 21:6 ; חֲפֵצָה נֶפֶשׁ willing soul 1Chr 28:9 ; plural construct before nouns absolute Psa 35:22 ; 40:15 = 70:3 ; לְכָלחֶֿפְצֵיהֶם דְּרוּשִׁים studied of all who take pleasure in them 111:2 . 2 of God , אַתָּה רֶשַׁע חָפֵץ אֵלֿ לֹא thou art not a God taking pleasure in wickedness Psa 5:5 .
